required_environment.name: QWEN_DIR
required_environment.purpose: Clean pinned Qwen3-TTS checkout that supplies the model package and dataset implementation.

required_environment.name: BASE_MODEL
required_environment.purpose: Pinned local base-model directory or immutable model identifier.

required_environment.name: TRAIN_JSONL
required_environment.purpose: Training manifest with precomputed Qwen audio codes.

required_environment.name: VAL_JSONL
required_environment.purpose: Held-out validation manifest from the same grouped corpus split.

required_environment.name: TEST_JSONL
required_environment.purpose: Held-out test manifest from the same grouped corpus split.

required_environment.name: DATASET_LINEAGE
required_environment.purpose: Content-addressed receipt binding audited splits to the manifests consumed by training.

required_environment.name: PERSISTED_PACKAGE_ROOT
required_environment.purpose: Existing external directory for immutable content-addressed lifecycle packages.

required_environment.name: SELECTED_CHECKPOINT_NAME
required_environment.purpose: Single safe full-model checkpoint directory created by training and selected for reload.

required_environment.name: GENERATION_PLAN
required_environment.purpose: Frozen Instavar Voice generation plan containing this candidate.

required_environment.name: CANDIDATE_ID
required_environment.purpose: Candidate identifier present in the frozen generation plan.
